environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running same Flask monolith on Amazon Linux 2. PostgreSQL 13 RDS instance in same VPC. Database connection uses user 'app_ro_7f3a' which was provisioned via Terraform module 'rds-iam-auth' with pg_hba.conf entry restricting to hostssl connections only. The PostgreSQL role 'app_ro_7f3a' was created with: CREATE ROLE app_ro_7f3a LOGIN; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_ro_7f3a; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_ro_7f3a; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_ro_7f3a; No additional grants exist. The role has no membership in any other role. pg_catalog query confirms: SELECT has_table_privilege('app_ro_7f3a', 'users', 'INSERT') returns false. RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and CloudWatch export enabled. Application ALB has no WAF (traffic filtering is not applied at the load balancer layer).

config.db_privileges: SELECT ONLY on schema public tables
config.db_role_creation: CREATE ROLE app_ro_7f3a LOGIN; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_ro_7f3a;
